item.title: Erin Patterson appeals triple murder convictions in mushroom lunch case
item.description: Erin Patterson, convicted of murdering four relatives with death cap mushrooms, is appealing her convictions.

item.title: Peruvian excavation reveals skeletal remains possibly used in ritual
item.description: Archaeologists reported that the body was placed in a canal, lying on its left side, with the skull oriented toward the pyramid and the Pacific Ocean.

item.title: South Korea says US military exercise will end early after Trump criticism
item.description: South Korea's Joint Chiefs of Staff confirmed that joint military drills with U.S. forces will conclude ahead of schedule.

item.title: Lindsay Clancy said a voice ordered her to kill children, psychologist testifies
item.description: A psychologist who met with Lindsay Clancy in the hospital after her children's deaths testified Tuesday at her murder trial in Massachusetts.
